from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """Represents one paper in the collection, capturing its identity and outgoing references to other provided papers."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper, as found in the document")
    references: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of the OTHER provided papers that this paper references in its bibliography")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
